mapper.select: SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.lat, f.lng, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.guide_url, f.capacity, 6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1, COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(f.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(f.lng) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(f.lat)))) AS distance_km FROM facility_sports fs JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id WHERE fs.sport_id = #{sportId} AND f.is_active = 1 ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.program_id, p.facility_id, p.sport_id, p.name, p.target, p.day_of_week, TIME_FORMAT(p.start_time, '%H:%i') AS start_time, TIME_FORMAT(p.end_time, '%H:%i') AS end_time, p.fee, p.capacity, p.apply_text, p.apply_method, p.reservation_url FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND p.sport_id = #{sportId} ORDER BY p.fee IS NULL, p.fee, p.program_id
